```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import Pkg
deps = Pkg.dependencies()                                 # every package in the site's environment
ver(name) = (i = findfirst(d -> d.name == name, collect(values(deps))); i === nothing ? "—" : string(collect(values(deps))[i].version))
pkgs = ["ConvolutionInterpolations", "Interpolations", "BSplineKit", "Dierckx", "FastChebInterp",
        "NumericalIntegration", "HCubature", "QuadGK", "ScatteredInterpolation", "NaturalNeighbours", "Chairmarks"]
println("---")
println()
println("*Rendered with Julia ", VERSION, " on a ", Sys.cpu_info()[1].model, " machine (", Sys.CPU_THREADS,
        " threads), with ", join((p * ".jl " * ver(p) for p in pkgs), ", "), ".*")
```
